about_the_game:
Jarney is a hand-drawn cartoon real-time strategy game. A great catastrophe shattered the world, and only a handful of survivors escaped by sealing themselves inside jars. Ages have passed, and life begins to stir once more, yet the land beneath your feet remains barren, incapable of yielding crops to sustain your people.

Don your ancestral relic, awaken long-sealed companions, and lead them on a journey for a new homeland. On the everchanging battlefield, can you make the right decision, command them through struggle, and respark the flame of civilization? Each playthrough brings a fresh experience and new challenges! Discover treasures, battle fearsome monsters, encounter mysterious merchants, and recruit even more companions along your adventure.

Wishlist now, and embark on this epic quest to rebuild your homeland and reawaken hope!
